analysis.rationale: R1 signal reinterpretation: (1) blur_subtype: run_full_analysis_R1 step3_blur verdict=GLASS_BLUR (glass_score=0.3044>0.25, sigma=0.37<3) and anisotropy=1.4991<1.7 excludes motion -> SKILL blur decision tree routes to glass; R0 defaulted to gaussian without PSNR-testing glass. (2) blur severity: gm_ratio=0.1377 includes the contrast contraction c=0.6, so severity 4 fits better than 5 (pair0: glass4 35.36 vs glass5 34.82 under identical globals). (3) step count / saturation: R0 added saturate_weaken_HSV:3 from chroma_ratio=0.5045, but CI showed unique_G sim-target diff -30 (28%) over-contraction; under stretch4 the sat axis is monotone (sat3 35.36 -> sat1 38.76 -> no sat 40.69), i.e. saturation was a false-positive step (full_analysis false_positive_checks.contrast_from_saturation=true) and chroma_ratio is explained by per-channel contrast_weaken_stretch c=0.6 alone. Removing it also fixed unique_G (diff -1, 1% on pair0; 0% on pair1/pair2), resolving the unique_G<200 compression/quantization rule without any JPEG or quantization step. (4) no JPEG: block_boundary=1.0024 (0% FP); no noise: sigma=0.37<2. k=3 validation of blur_glass:4 + contrast_weaken_stretch:4: 40.69 / 38.27 / 43.57 dB (mean 40.84, +7.98 dB vs R0 mean 32.86; +6.40 / +10.13 / +7.43 per pair), CI 9/10, 10/10, 9/10. CHANGE threshold met (>40 dB on pair0/pair2 and +2 dB on every pair).
